text: This project uses DuckDB with a single documents table; always upsert via ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE, never re-run a raw INSERT for an id that might already exist.
All services in this repo run only through Docker Compose. Do not add local (non-Docker) run instructions to any README or skill file.
Claude Code skills in this repo follow one pattern: a SKILL.md plus a scripts/ subdirectory, keeping model-facing instructions separate from executable script logic.
Embeddings are produced by common/embeddings.py's mock_embed function. Any retrieval code must call that same function used at ingestion time, or similarity scores become meaningless.
Gotcha: DuckDB's ui extension only binds to 127.0.0.1, so a docker-compose service exposing it needs network_mode: host on Linux, not a plain ports mapping.
Decision: promoted domain and model onto dedicated columns on the documents table instead of leaving them nested in the metadata JSON, so retrieval filtering can use a plain SQL WHERE clause.
In billing-service, all currency amounts are stored as integer minor units (cents), never floats. A past incident was caused by float rounding drift in an invoice total.
billing-service's retrieval layer embeds each transaction memo with the same vector model used for search indexing, both defined in common/embeddings.py.
The Docker container for billing-service must run as a non-root user; the Dockerfile sets USER app after installing dependencies.
